author: Second Wind
description:
Tragic stories can be invigorating and emotionally taxing. When do you want to use them, what purpose do they serve, and how can you utilize them correctly? Elliot Davis from More Blueberries and Jesse Galena discuss and take your questions.

title: Telling Tragic Stories with Elliot Davis of More Blueberries | RPG Help Desk (Part 2)
